objective: Establish a performance baseline and implement reusable pooling utilities to reduce runtime allocations and GC pressure.
prerequisites: Access to gameplay code under Assets/Core/ and Assets/Scripts/

steps.title: Instrumentation & Baseline
steps.description: Add profiling markers, run scenarios, and record frame-time and allocation metrics under benchmarks/.

steps.title: Low-Risk Pooling Implementation
steps.description: Create a lightweight Pool<T> and GameObjectPool under Assets/Scripts/Utilities/Pooling/ and implement warm-up semantics.

steps.title: Integrate & Replace Instantiation Sites
steps.description: Replace high-churn Instantiate/Destroy sites with pooling where it yields measurable benefit.

steps.title: Re-benchmark & Validate
steps.description: Re-run benchmarks, compare metrics, and ensure no regressions.

steps.title: Documentation & Deliverables
steps.description: Add migration guide, usage examples, and store benchmark results in the plan folder.

notes: Use Unity Profiler markers for editor runs and headless batch mode for CI.
Prefer minimal, well-tested changes when replacing allocation hotspots.
Record before/after benchmark snapshots to the plan folder for traceability.
